senses.gloss: f. (פָּסַל; cmp. פגם) defective, blemished, unfit, disqualified, opp. כשר.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 2:1">Zeb. II, 1</cite> <he>נשפך ואספו פ׳ …</he> if the blood was spilt over the pavement, and one collects it again, it is unfit for sprinkling.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:4">Ḥull. I, 4</cite> <he>שחיטתו פ׳</he> his slaughtering act is illegitimate (the animal so slaughtered is forbidden to be eaten).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כשר בשחיטה פ׳ במליקה וכ׳</he> what is right in slaughtering, is illegal in pinching (the neck) &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 3:2">Zeb. III, 2</cite> <he>קבל הכשר ונתן לפ׳</he> if a person qualified for the service received the blood and handed it to one disqualified.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:13">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> <he>אליעזר פְּסוּל הבית היה וכ׳</he> Eliezer was the disqualified (servant) of the house, and yet it is written &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:6">Kidd. IV, 6</cite> <he>פ׳ מן הכהונה לעולם</he> is forever unfit for priesthood (his female descendants are forbidden to priests); <he>בתו פ׳ לכהונה</he> his daughter cannot marry a priest; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּסוּלִים</he>, <he>פְּסוּלִין</he>; <he>פְּסוּלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:3">Snh. III, 3</cite> <he>אלו הן הפ׳</he> the following are disqualified (for judges or witnesses).
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 9:4">Gitt. IX, 4</cite> <he>שלשה גטין פ׳</he> three kinds of letters of divorce are invalid.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 3:1">Zeb. III, 1</cite> <he>כל הפ׳ ששחטו וכ׳</he> if any of those unfit for priestly service did the slaughtering, his act is legal.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 77a:15">Kidd. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שנולדה מן הפ׳</he> born of disqualified parents; <he>מאי פ׳ אילימא פ׳ לו</he> what do you mean by ‘disqualified’? Do you mean disqualified (forbidden in marriage) to him (the father)? <cite ref="Kiddushin 77a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>פְּסוּלֵי כהונה</he> persons disqualified for the priesthood (degraded priests). Y. ib. III, 64ᶜ <he>כשרין הוזהרו על הפ׳ וכ׳</he> qualified persons are cautioned (in the Law) not to marry disqualified women, … but qualified women are not forbidden to marry disqualified men.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 7:7">Shek. VII, 7</cite> <he>הקינין הפ׳</he> consecrated birds that became disqualified (or unavailable) for sacrificial purposes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 5:1">Bekh. V, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>פסולי המוקדשים</he> dedicated objects which became unfit for the purpose to which they were dedicated; a. v. fr.
